value.rationale: The canonical nonlinear Rule 18 has quasi-additive parity domains and exceptional kink dynamics. A genuine first odd temporal recurrence is a natural, previously non-implied structural threshold. The paired universal short-odd obstruction and sharp eleven-site appearance, with an exact two-orbit multiplicity, is a meaningful finite/infinite quantifier boundary rather than an arbitrary single parameter computation. The value does not depend on overstated all-period classifications.
